revisionHints.description: The HTTP GET upgrade requires a live opaque API-v3 bearer session. The server sends revision_committed after a durable canonical commit and resync_required whenever exact hint continuity is uncertain. Clients do not send application messages; text and binary input are ignored and never mutate state.
revisionHints.title: Authenticated revision hints

resyncRequired.name: resync_required
resyncRequired.summary: Hint continuity is uncertain; discard delta assumptions and fetch full authenticated projections.
resyncRequired.title: Full HTTP resynchronization required

revisionCommitted.name: revision_committed
revisionCommitted.summary: A game visible to the authenticated account has a new canonical revision.
revisionCommitted.title: Canonical revision committed

opaqueBearerSession.description: Opaque revocable API-v3 session token. This is not a JWT.

info.description: Authenticated WebSocket hints for API-v3 canonical revision changes. Frames are non-authoritative: clients always reconcile through authenticated HTTP projections.
info.title: Unciv authoritative multiplayer notifications

receiveRevisionHint.description: Receive is from the client application's perspective. Duplicate, missing, delayed, or reordered hints are expected and cannot authorize or commit gameplay.
receiveRevisionHint.summary: Receive one of the two closed server message shapes.
receiveRevisionHint.title: Receive a revision or resynchronization hint

deployed.description: The API-v3 deployment. Plain ws is not a production transport.

authority.description: Deployment-specific DNS authority and optional port.

x-unciv-lifecycle.authority: Messages are hints only. Canonical state changes only through typed HTTP commands executed by the private Kotlin engine and committed by Rust.
x-unciv-lifecycle.connect: Fetch the latest authenticated game list and projection before relying on hints.
x-unciv-lifecycle.delivery: At-most-transient hints may be duplicated, delayed, reordered, or lost. HTTP revision and projection hashes determine convergence.
x-unciv-lifecycle.disconnect: Reconnect with bounded exponential delay and jitter, then fetch full authenticated projections.
x-unciv-lifecycle.heartbeat: The server sends numbered WebSocket Ping control frames. The peer must answer with Pong; arbitrary application data does not extend liveness.
x-unciv-lifecycle.lag: A bounded local queue emits resync_required instead of replaying guessed revisions.
